units.source_text: 纪伊守也是个轻薄之徒，艳羡这后母的姿色，常思接近，好献殷勤，因此巴结这个小君，常常陪他一同来去。

en.t: The Governor of Kii was also a frivolous man; admiring the beauty of this stepmother, he was always thinking of ways to get near her and pay court to her, and so he ingratiated himself with Kogimi and often accompanied him back and forth.

units.source_text: 源氏公子召唤小君进去，恨恨地对他说：“昨天我等了你一天！

en.t: Prince Genji summoned Kogimi in and said to him resentfully, “I waited for you all day yesterday!

units.source_text: 可见你是不把我放在心上的。”

en.t: It seems you do not keep me in your thoughts at all.”

units.source_text: 小君脸红了。

en.t: Kogimi blushed.

units.source_text: 公子又问：“回信呢？”

en.t: The prince asked again, “What about the reply?”

units.source_text: 小君只得一五一十地把实情告诉他。

en.t: Kogimi had no choice but to tell him the whole truth, from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 公子说：“你这个人靠不住。

en.t: The prince said, “You are an unreliable fellow.

units.source_text: 哪有这等事情！”

en.t: How could such a thing happen!”

units.source_text: 便叫他再送一封信去，对他说：“你这孩子不知道：你姐姐认识伊豫介这个老头子以前，先和我相识了。

en.t: Then he told him to take another letter and said to him, “You child, you do not know this: before your sister knew that old man Iyo no Suke, she first became acquainted with me.

units.source_text: 不过，她嫌我文弱不可靠，因此嫁了那个硬朗的老头子，真是欺侮我！

en.t: But she thought me delicate and unreliable, so she married that sturdy old man instead. She has truly insulted me!

units.source_text: 如今你就做我的儿子吧。

en.t: From now on, then, you shall be my son.

units.source_text: 你姐姐所依靠的那个老头子，寿命不长了。”

en.t: That old man your sister depends on will not live much longer.”

units.source_text: 小君听了，心中想道：“原来如此！

en.t: Hearing this, Kogimi thought to himself, “So that is how it is!

units.source_text: 姐姐不理睬他，也太忍心了。”

en.t: It is terribly heartless of my sister to pay him no attention.”

units.source_text: 源氏公子便疼爱这孩子，时刻不离地要他在身边，也常常带他进宫去。

en.t: Prince Genji then grew fond of the boy, kept him constantly at his side, and often took him into the palace.

units.source_text: 又命宫中裁缝所替他新制服装，待他真同父母对儿子一样。

en.t: He also ordered the palace sewing office to make new clothes for him, treating him just as parents would treat their own son.

units.source_text: 此后源氏公子还是常常要他送信。

en.t: After that, Prince Genji still often had him carry letters.

units.source_text: 但空蝉想：这毕竟是个小孩，万一把消息泄漏出去，此身又将添得一个轻薄的恶名。

en.t: But Utsusemi thought: after all, he is only a child, and if he should let the matter slip, I would gain yet another shameful reputation for frivolity.

units.source_text: 公子的多情她也觉得很感谢；然而无论何等恩宠，一想起自己身份不配，便决心不受，因此始终不曾写过恳切的回信。

en.t: She was grateful for the prince’s deep affection; yet no matter how great his favor, whenever she remembered that her own station was unworthy, she resolved not to accept it, and so she never wrote him a heartfelt reply.

units.source_text: 她也常常想起：那天晚上邂逅相逢的那个人的神情风采，的确英爽俊秀，非同凡俗。

en.t: She, too, often remembered the bearing and appearance of the man she had met by chance that night; he was indeed handsome, spirited, and far from ordinary.

units.source_text: 然而一想起便立刻自己打消念头。

en.t: Yet whenever she thought of him, she immediately dismissed the thought herself.

units.source_text: 她想：我的身份已定，现在向他表示殷勤，有何用处呢？

en.t: She thought: my position is already fixed, so what use would there be in showing him kindness now?

units.source_text: 源氏公子则无时不思量她。

en.t: Prince Genji, for his part, thought of her at every moment.

units.source_text: 一想起她，总觉又是可怜，又是可爱。

en.t: Whenever he thought of her, he always found her both pitiable and dear.

units.source_text: 回思那天晚上她那忧伤悲痛的样子，不胜怜悯，始终无法自慰。

en.t: When he recalled her sorrowful, grief-stricken manner that night, he was overcome with pity and could never console himself.

units.source_text: 然而轻率地偷偷去访，则彼处人目众多，深恐暴露了自己的胡行妄为，对那人也是不利的，因此踌躇不决。

en.t: Yet if he rashly went to visit her in secret, there were many eyes in that place; fearing that his own reckless misconduct would be exposed and that it would also harm her, he remained hesitant and undecided.
